title: —I’m melting, he said, as the candle remarked when... But, hush! Not a word more on that subject!
html_source: Some critics gloss Mulligan’s unfinished joke as a vulgar reference to the idea of a woman using a candle as a dildo. He cuts himself off, possibly finding it too inappropriate to say at the breakfast table, although this may just be feigned propriety in line with his mock priest routine.
